metadata.description: Candidate road-link endpoints whose nearest endpoint on another road part is within the configured 10 m endpoint snap distance.
metadata.algorithm: For each road-part start/end, find the nearest endpoint on a different road part. Include endpoints more than 0.01 m and no more than 10 m apart. Haversine distance in meters. These are candidates for review, not a claim that the backend build actually snapped every one.
